words.sense: To take over the established role or place of something or someone, displacing it.
misconceptions: Thinking any addition automatically displaces what was there.

words.sense: To add an extra resource or element while what was there remains in use.
misconceptions: Thinking popularity alone proves an old option has been replaced.

semantic_axes.description: Supplant means the new thing takes over an old role; supplement means it adds help while the old thing retains its role.
